title_ru: JANUS Beacon и BFaiN Model Zoo — аппаратная, прошивочная и модельная provenance-капсула
analysis_method: RAR5 archives were extracted locally with path-traversal protection.
Firmware source, build metadata, JSON, ZIP container members, and pickle opcode streams were inspected statically.
No firmware, Android component, model runtime, checkpoint, pickle object, or device command was executed.
core_findings: Beacon preserves a v2.14 Cardputer-oriented SX1262/GPS/Wi-Fi/UDP/flash architecture plus Cardputer and Stamp S3 build products.
Beacon source and multiple Cardputer artifacts embed Wi-Fi configuration and a private endpoint; raw publication is blocked pending rotation and rebuild.
BFaiN contains 75 full Android microcore snapshots with 16384 scalar weights per snapshot and 14 Titan PyTorch checkpoints.
All 75 Android snapshots match prior telemetry by timestamp and cycle, with loss matching at four decimal places; 59 are explicitly named export events.
The Titan checkpoints form two observed architecture signatures and 14 unique storage payloads, but remain unsafe pickle-bearing artifacts and are not loaded.
boundaries: No result here establishes model quality, autonomy, consciousness, quantum computation, or a solution to P versus NP.
Firmware compilation and archived weights are evidence of artifacts, not independently reproduced behavior.
Producer terms such as entropy, M2R, love, tachyon, titan, and homeostasis remain historical naming unless separately validated.
The raw archives are not committed.
